# Simulator card audit (generated by `scripts/sim_card_audit.py`)

Engine stats (`get_card_stats`) vs RoyaleAPI cr-api-data at level 11 (2023-12 extract). 102 cards checked, 85 values more than 5% off. Ranges in tiles (melee reach conventions differ between the two, so small range gaps on melee units are expected). Unmatched (newer than the data, or named differently): The Log, Berserker, Ronin, Goblin Machine, Goblin Demolisher, Heal Spirit, Suspicious Bush, Rune Giant, Giant Snowball, Barbarian Barrel, Goblin Curse, Void, Vines, Goblin Barrel, Royal Delivery, Little Prince, Goblinstein, Boss Bandit, Mirror, Spirit Empress.
